series.$note: series.observed holds several sources and must not be read as one curve. DS-35: All greenhouse gases including land-use change, GWP100 (OWID, from Climate Watch / PIK), from 1990. DS-02: Asset-level observed emissions, CO₂e GWP100 (Climate TRACE); land use accounted differently from OWID, 2015-2025. Points from an NDC document are that document's own inventory basis. The same year can appear more than once with different values; R3 keeps them side by side and never averages them.

finance_listing.$reason: The Green Climate Fund's project list, read on 2026-10-26 (372 projects of every status: 333 Under Implementation, 16 Approved, 9 Lapsed, 8 Completed, 6 Discontinued), names no project for Saint Helena. The Fund's Governing Instrument (paragraph 35, page 12) reads: "All developing country Parties to the Convention are eligible to receive resources from the Fund." The UN Treaty Collection status of the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (XXVII-7) does not list Saint Helena as a participant, and no note or declaration in it names Saint Helena.
finance_listing.$note: The Fund's readiness support is approved outside this project list, so this does not say Saint Helena received nothing from the Fund.

by_source.scope: All greenhouse gases including land-use change, GWP100 (OWID, from Climate Watch / PIK)
Asset-level observed emissions, CO₂e GWP100 (Climate TRACE); land use accounted differently from OWID
Non-CO₂ greenhouse gases only (CH₄, N₂O, F-gases), AR5 GWP100, excluding LULUCF (EDGAR 2024). CO₂ is omitted for licence reasons, so this is not a national total.

emissions_profile.$note: Headline totals are OWID only. OWID's CO₂ sub-totals are fossil/industrial CO₂ by fuel, not a full sectoral GHG breakdown, and do not sum to total_mtco2e. DS-05's rows are non-CO₂ gases only and are not comparable with the others; that is also why DS-05 is absent from series.observed, where a shorter curve would read as a disagreement rather than a difference of scope. by_source carries each source whole.

verdict.text: The UN Treaty Collection status of the Paris Agreement (XXVII-7-d) does not list Saint Helena as a participant, and no note or declaration in it names Saint Helena. 46 observed values are loaded from DS-02 (11), DS-35 (35). For 2024 the sources disagree: DS-02 0.1 MtCO₂e, DS-35 0 MtCO₂e. They are on different inventory scopes and the engine does not reconcile them. No implementation gap is reported: 35 observed years are loaded, but Saint Helena is not listed as a Party to the Paris Agreement (UN Treaty Collection, XXVII-7-d), so no NDC target is held to measure the trend against. Projected warming for 2080-2099 against 1995-2014 ranges from +0.74°C under SSP1-2.6 to +2.68°C under SSP5-8.5. These are model runs, not observations.
